invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.

Project is the universal recursive work primitive: task, subtask, phase, milestone and work package semantics are represented through explicit Project identities/relations rather than parallel work primitives.

semantics.action_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] create-child/move/update/apply operations use separate authorized workflows. [2] Create/edit/move/activate/complete operations invoke separate authorized canonical operations.
semantics.aggregation_rule: Visual rollups never invent semantic aggregation rules.
semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Viewing/dragging Project tree grants no Project authority. [2] Viewing hierarchy does not grant Project participation/edit authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Parent/child edges correspond only to explicit containment refs. [2] Hierarchy graph edges correspond to explicit Project relations.
semantics.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Project, containment edge, participant evidence, time atom and result identities remain distinct. [2] Project, child Project, execution, publication and Merit evidence identities remain separate.
semantics.readonly_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Default is read-only; structure edits are candidate changes. [2] Monitor is read-only by default.
semantics.trace_rule: Derived status/evidence projections retain exact source refs.
